title: Typographic Poster Design
coreRelationships: The large vertical 'GRAPHY' text is the primary visual anchor, intersected by the circular 'ypo' element.
The dark gray and light beige color blocks divide the composition vertically, creating a strong contrast.
The large, bold 'IMPACT' text at the bottom serves as a powerful concluding statement, contrasting with the smaller text above it.
The dense block of small text on the left side of the beige panel provides informational contrast to the larger, more artistic text elements.
The arrangement of smaller words in vertical stacks (e.g., 'CONSIDERED', 'SHOULD', 'OUGHT', 'MIGHT', 'COULD') creates a structured, almost architectural feel.
reuseFormula: Create a vertical two-tone background with a dark neutral on the left and a light neutral on the right. Place a large, vertically oriented sans-serif word or phrase on the right side, intersected by a smaller, contrasting circular graphic in an accent color. Stack smaller, related sans-serif words vertically to the left of the main vertical text, varying their weight and color. Include a dense block of small, legible sans-serif text on the left side of the light neutral panel. Conclude the composition with a large, bold, wide sans-serif word or phrase at the bottom, spanning across the vertical division.

For the main display text, use a bold geometric sans-serif, rotated 90 degrees, aligned vertically on the right beige panel. For the smaller display text, use a bold geometric sans-serif, rotated 90 degrees, aligned vertically on the bottom-left and bottom-right of the beige panel. For the 'IMPACT' text, use an extra-bold geometric sans-serif, large scale, at the bottom of the beige panel. For the 'ypo' element, create custom vector lettering for 'yp' within a perfect red circle, positioned within the main display text. For the body text, use a regular weight geometric sans-serif, all caps, small size, in a narrow vertical column on the dark gray panel. For the metadata, use a regular weight geometric sans-serif, all caps, extra-small size, at the bottom of the dark gray panel.
